description: Brown floodwater covers a street of tall stone tenement buildings and fills the ground-level flats. A young woman in a yellow jacket sits in a wooden rowing boat right outside an open front door and paddles away from the building, the water swirling behind the boat. Tables and chairs are piled up inside the flooded room beside her, and a sofa and sandbags stand in the water outside. Above, a neighbour leans out of a dry upper window. A bicycle stands in the water.
